migration_assessment.generic_allow: Reject get_prop(hal_fingerprint_default,system_prop): exposes the whole sys. area to solve one unproven metadata key.
migration_assessment.vendor_relabel: Do not add sys.panel.touch_vendor to vendor property_contexts with a vendor type. system/sepolicy/build/soong/selinux_contexts.go:364–381 allowed vendor property prefixes omit sys.; strict namespace check at404–405. No namespace bypass should be introduced.
migration_assessment.platform_exact_type: A dedicated exact core-owned public/restricted property type could preserve the immutable ELF key, but requires identifying the real producer and consumer set, policy ownership/export/version compatibility, and enforcing tests. None is proven sufficiently here.
migration_assessment.vendor_key_rename: Changing to vendor.panel.touch_vendor requires changing the proprietary getter/producer or a verified compatible wrapper. Pure property_contexts relabel does not rename keys; mirroring needs a real authoritative producer and lifecycle. Not proposed.
migration_assessment.recommended_disposition: Leave this candidate round unchanged. Treat the statically established empty/failed-read fallback as a bounded metadata path, not an established authentication blocker or a proven Enforcing success. Investigate further if enforcing causes a matching fingerprint/init problem or producer evidence appears.
